label: Particle limiter
description: Caps live particles, skips the ones outside your view, and thins out block-break and explosion bursts.
settings_description: Settings for the Particle limiter gameplay mod. Vanilla builds the vertices of every live particle every frame, including the half behind you, and a TNT run or a Bedwars bed break can put thousands on screen at once. `frustum_cull` is free — a particle outside the view cone is never seen — and is the default win. The two fractions thin a burst at the moment it is spawned; they only ever remove particles, never add one, which is the direction Hypixel's allowlist has no objection to. Crit, sharpness and hit particles are untouched by both: they are the cue that a hit landed.

frustum_cull.description: Whether particles outside the camera's view cone skip their draw. Invisible by construction, which is why it is on by default and why it is a switch rather than a number.

particle_cap.description: Most particles alive per render layer; when full, the oldest goes first, exactly as vanilla does at its own limit. 4000 is vanilla's limit, so the default changes nothing — lower it if explosions stall your frame.

block_break_particles.description: Fraction of block-break and block-hit particles kept. 1 is vanilla's 64-piece burst; 0 breaks blocks with no debris. A bridging or Bedwars player breaks hundreds of blocks a game and every one used to spawn 64 particles.

explosion_particles.description: Fraction of explosion particles kept — TNT, fireballs and creepers. 1 is vanilla. The blast itself, its sound and its knockback are untouched; only the smoke is thinned.
